content:
Add a new user to your platform: POST /platform/v1/register-platform-account

This endpoint registers an existing DrorPay user as a user on your platform. You must call this before the user can participate in platform transactions.

Headers required: 
- Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
- X-Platform-Secret: <secret>
- X-Platform-Code: <code>

Request body:
- business_id (string UUID, optional): If the user is being registered under a specific business account, provide the business UUID. Otherwise, it defaults to null for personal accounts.

The backend automatically extracts the user_id from the JWT token and the platform_id from the platform code. It will upsert the platform account (create it if it doesn't exist, or update it if it does).

Response:
- id: The newly created (or existing) platform_users record ID.

Get connected accounts for a user: GET /platform/v1/user-account-list

Headers required: 
- Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
- X-Platform-Secret: <secret>
- X-Platform-Code: <code>

This endpoint returns the list of platform accounts connected to the authenticated user on the current platform. It uses the user_id from the JWT and the platform_id from the platform headers.

Response includes a list of account objects.

Get list of all platform users: GET /platform/v1/platform-users

Headers required: 
- Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
- X-Platform-Secret: <secret>
- X-Platform-Code: <code>

Query Parameters:
- type (string, optional): Can be 'merchant' to fetch only merchant users, or 'user' for regular users. If omitted, it may fetch all users based on backend configuration.

This endpoint returns a paginated or full list of all users registered on the platform, allowing the platform developer to see their user base.

Get platform user account details: GET /platform/v1/user/account

Headers required: 
- Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
- X-Platform-Secret: <secret>
- X-Platform-Code: <code>

This endpoint fetches the detailed profile information for the authenticated platform user. It extracts the user_id from the JWT token and returns the corresponding account details.
